text: Next: the List, through the Screen room's left-hand door, then the small room's left-hand door.
Make a row of tiles that isn't anywhere in the librarian's list.
A library, and a list that claims to hold everything. Read the plaque to the right of the list.
Set the switches on the desk to make a row, then press CHECK.
Your row differs from every row in the list, even the ones you can't see.
The librarian added your row. Make a row that still isn't in the list.
The librarian has added your row to the list. Can you beat it again?
Answer the question on the left-hand wall: which list could hold every endless row?
Beaten again, the same way. Now answer the question on the left-hand wall.
Every room solved. Wander as you like.
